title: [Bug] Terminal auto-scrolls to buffer start when model writes output during scroll-up
body:
**Bug Description**
In a windows console (Windows 11 "new" terminal), if we scroll up a little bit to sneak what recently happend in the session while the model is working, as soon something new is written by the model, the terminal is getting scrolled all the way up to the very beginning of the buffer. That's extremely annoying.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: win32
- Terminal: windows-terminal
- Version: 2.1.77
- Feedback ID: aad02164-1782-428e-9db9-161ecaa70ecc
author: carldebilly
